pages.title: 30 Years & 30 Alumni: 1994 – 2003 | Red & Yellow
pages.description: In celebration of 30 years of Creative Magic & Commercial Logic, we’re shining a spotlight on 30 alumni who have helped shape their industries, disrupt markets, and create lasting impact across the globe. In our 30 Years & 30 Alumni blog series, we’ll share the journeys, insights, and achievements of these remarkable graduates — from founding pioneering agencies to leading iconic brands, our alumni embody the Red & Yellow spirit of being a sponge.
h2: “Nine out of 10 things I do fail, which is why I do 10 things.”
“Always follow the energy. If it feels exciting, interesting, scary, or energised, then lean in and say yes. Your contribution counts!”
“Craft the heck out of your work, until it’s ready to be delivered in the most provocative, interesting and entertaining way.”

“My education taught me about the power of creativity. It’s transformed how I think about the world and how I think about problems. It’s something I’ve learnt at Red & Yellow and it’s something I use every day.”
“Always do work that makes culture, makes waves and makes a difference.”
“Never give up on the ideas that excite you to the core… they are worth the fight.””
“Don’t stand on ceremony. Do what makes sense to you.”
“Embrace a growth mindset, and dive in, figuring things out along the way. As Red & Yellow wisely puts it, be a sponge!”

pages.title: 30 Years & 30 Alumni: 2004 – 2013 | Red & Yellow
pages.description: In celebration of 30 years of Creative Magic & Commercial Logic, we’re shining a spotlight on 30 alumni who have helped shape their industries, disrupt markets, and create lasting impact across the globe. In our 30 Years & 30 Alumni blog series, we’ll share the journeys, insights, and achievements of these remarkable graduates — from founding pioneering agencies to leading iconic brands, our alumni embody the Red & Yellow spirit of being a sponge. Read on for the 30 Years & 30 Alumni: 2004 – 2013 cohort, click here to see who made the 1994 – 2003 list.
h2: “Dream in decades. Plan in years. Prioritise in months. Schedule in weeks. Start now.”
“Talent will get you hired, but drive is the thing that will get you noticed. Be hungry to make great work and you’ll be surprised how far you go.”

“Everything I learnt at Red & Yellow, I use in my everyday life in the music industry. The way the school opens your creative mind makes you more receptive to success in any industry. I used my Copywriting diploma to learn how to write the best hooks in songs… and all of the advertising and marketing skills have also been invaluable to promoting our music. Its a brilliant and hands-on place to grow in confidence as a young person with vision.”
“Never compete. Acquire knowledge, sharpen your skills, cultivate whatever natural talents you have and let results surprise you, and others.”
“It sounds obvious, but don’t be afraid to fail. Taking creative risks is so iconic – why be something for everyone when you can be everything for someone?”
“Be your authentic self; the industry needs you, not a version that you think people will accept.”

“Creating, building and selling something that’s rooted in what you believe in – provided it’s a good product with market relevance – is more than half the battle won. Find and work with people whose skillsets complement yours.”

pages.title: 30 Years & 30 Alumni: 2014 – now | Red & Yellow
pages.description: In celebration of 30 years of Creative Magic & Commercial Logic, we’re shining a spotlight on 30 alumni who have helped shape their industries, disrupt markets, and create lasting impact across the globe. Read on for the 30 Years & 30 Alumni: 2014 – 2013 cohort. Click here to see who made the 1994 – 2003 list, and catch up with the 2004-2013 list here.
h2: “It doesn’t matter how much or how little experience you have, always be open and never assume that you know everything.”
“Sell something and then figure out how to build it.”
“Master the small, unsexy tasks as consistency and character come from doing the boring stuff. Build credibility with yourself first.”
“Create from your culture. South Africa’s rich history is full of insights — use it to your advantage to craft powerful work.”
“Dream big, learn everything about anything, hoard insights, and talk to people outside your usual circles. Your career will connect you to the world — embrace how it feels.”
“Stay curious and unafraid to experiment—creativity thrives in the unknown. Build on your values; they’re the foundation of authentic and impactful work.”
